definitions.explanation: doing something again, often with a fresh perspective or renewed attention
doing something in a proper or formal manner, especially when previous occasions were informal

examples.japanese: {改|あらた}めて⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}います→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I want to thank you again formally.

examples.japanese: {改|あらた}めて⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧みた。
{改|あらた}めてご⟦{連絡|れんらく}します→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you again later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{改|あらた}めて⟦{尊敬|そんけい}した→尊敬する：22429_sonkeisuru⟧。
examples.english: Hearing his story, I came to respect him anew.

examples.japanese: {改|あらた}めて⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{改|あらた}めて⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}しましょう→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in polite or formal contexts. Can indicate:
- Doing something again with fresh attention
- Doing something properly/formally (as opposed to casually)
- Rescheduling for a later time
Implies intention and deliberateness, not just simple repetition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {改|あらた}めて + verb - to do ~ again/properly
- {改|あらた}めて⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ - to think anew
- {改|あらた}めて⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ - to feel anew

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧ - one more time
- ⟦{再度|さいど}→再度：11690_saido⟧ - once again (formal)
